## Common-rate numerical comparisons

Main: eight-model common measured intervals,100 uniform ln(bpp) points,PCHIP,no extrapolation. Paired metrics use video-equal weights; pooled FID uses dataset-mean actual bpp. Relative%=100*(dataset method mean-dataset reference mean)/dataset reference mean,not BD-rate or mean of video percentages. D_mu/D_cov component diagnostics use the same linear ln(bpp) weights for closure and are labelled separately from primary PCHIP FID. Unavailable common intervals are retained; fallback tables are explicitly pairwise. Difference-of-differences is a raw metric contrast on the same eight-model grid,without a percentage denominator.

## Files

evaluation_points.csv/per_sequence_all_qp.csv and evaluation/provenance.csv contain every logical point and source. per_frame.csv/transitions.csv retain64frames/63transitions. pooled_fid.csv/fid_decomposition_raw.csv contain fixed-pool FID,mean/covariance terms and GT hashes. equal_rate_summary.csv/equal_rate_per_sequence.csv/common_rate_grid.csv/common_intervals.csv retain means,intervals,inputs and interpolation labels. difference_of_differences.csv and trajectory_3QP.csv separate contrasts and matched three-QP trajectories. high_rate_actual_points.csv lists HEVC-B/MCL measured points with the predefined upper-third common ln(bpp) threshold; same QP is not claimed to be same rate. rate_sign_ranges.csv records interpolated-grid sign runs,not extra measured encodes.

Binary artifacts remain server-only,with path/size/SHA in binary_artifacts_index.json. final_integrity.json and publication_status.json separate execution and remote publication.
